commits.message:
refactor: Complete enterprise-grade architecture overhaul

Major refactoring of Game of Three implementation:

Architecture:
- Migrated from Spring Boot 1.3.3 to Spring Boot 3.2.1 with Java 17
- Implemented Clean Architecture (Hexagonal) with proper layer separation
- Applied Domain-Driven Design patterns throughout
- Replaced deprecated Velocity templates with Thymeleaf

Domain Layer (pure Java, no dependencies):
- Value Objects: GameId, PlayerId, PlayerNumber
- Entities: Game (aggregate root), Player, Move
- Domain Events: PlayerJoinedEvent, GameStartedEvent, MoveMadeEvent, GameFinishedEvent
- Custom exceptions with error codes

Application Layer:
- Use Cases: CreateGameUseCase, MakeMoveUseCase, GetGameUseCase
- Input/Output Ports for dependency inversion
- Service implementations with proper transaction boundaries

Infrastructure Layer:
- REST API with OpenAPI/Swagger documentation
- WebSocket support with STOMP for real-time gameplay
- In-memory repository with ConcurrentHashMap
- Global exception handling with standardized error responses

Testing:
- Comprehensive unit tests for domain models
- Use case tests with mocks
- Integration tests for REST API
- Architecture tests using ArchUnit

DevOps:
- Multi-stage Dockerfile for optimized images
- Docker Compose configuration
- GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline with test coverage

Documentation:
- Comprehensive README with architecture diagrams
- API reference documentation
- Configuration guide
